title: Launch price for the series
question: What launch price do we set for the masterclass series?
expected: 30 sales in the first 10 days, average order value ≥ €1,500.

frame.problem: The launch offer and the sales pitch cannot be finalised without a price. What price structure do we launch the masterclass series with?

vars.name: Speed of the first 30 sales
vars.ctx: The €50k KR needs momentum in the first 10 days; the sales team needs a reason to call now.

vars.name: Perceived value
vars.ctx: A discount that looks permanent anchors the series low for every later cohort.

vars.name: Cash per sale
vars.ctx: Average order value target is €1,500. Instalments help conversion but delay cash.

opts.name: Early-bird then full price
opts.desc: €990 for 10 days, then €1,490. Creates urgency, keeps the anchor.

opts.name: Single price
opts.desc: €1,490 from day one. Clean anchor, no urgency lever.

opts.name: Payment plan
opts.desc: 3 × €530. Lowers the entry ticket, spreads the cash.
